name: live-regtest
operatorNotes: Credentials: /stress/credentials.json on each load-gen VM (mode 600), shaped like .stress-runs/local/credentials.json: provider accounts are the owner's verified account(s) with a portal API key; buyer accounts likewise; lnd.payee is the regtest payee node's REST URL, macaroon and cert (reachable from the VM, e.g. through `fly proxy`); tokens.admin is optional (enables /ledger/verify and /admin/payouts/reconciliation evidence).
coordinator-kill on live only prints the fly machine stop/start commands; the operator runs them.
db-slowdown and payout-storm are local only (direct Postgres; payout-storm calls the coordinator payout route with the portal service token, which on live sits behind the portal's emailed-code step).
